### Shaonlee Patranabis

Economic geographer and post-doctoral researcher at [Imago](https://imago.liverpool.ac.uk), University of Liverpool, and Visiting Fellow at the [LSE Department of Geography and Environment](https://www.lse.ac.uk/geography-and-environment). My research sits at the intersection of urban economics, colonial institutional history, and spatial inequality — with a growing interest in satellite remote sensing as a way to bring new data to bear on questions about cities in the Global South.

My PhD at LSE examined how colonial and contemporary institutions shape persistent patterns of urban development and inequality in India.

I love making maps, petting cats, and exploring cities.
